title: The Drained Pool Gallery
subtitle: A 1970s sanctuary reclaimed by light.
line: Descend into the hollow of a forgotten pool where light is the only remaining fluid.
quote: To empty the space is to fill it with vision.
synopsis: You step down into the raw concrete expanse of a drained 1970s indoor pool, where the familiar echoes of water are replaced by a profound, silent stillness. At the center of the deep, you encounter the fragmented prismatic light source, a basin of brilliance that shatters the dim, cavernous atmosphere. You weave between mineral-white monoliths displaying eyewear, each station catching the spectral reflections cast across the clay floor. The journey concludes at the back, where the polished concrete desk awaits in the soft, glowing fog.

why.d: A floor strip (entryway staircase landing) runs 4.7 m from the door toward the hero (fragmented prismatic light source). The landing invites you to descend, shifting your perception from the street level to the subterranean floor of the pool.
The hero stands alone 5.6 m inside the door, 3.5 m tall; nothing else rises above 1.8 m. This basin acts as the physical embodiment of water, turning light into a tangible presence in the empty room.

Four product stations (product display monoliths) ring it loosely, 0.4 m from the route at the closest. These stations create a meditative path that mimics the movement of currents, guiding you naturally toward the product.
The pay counter (polished payment desk) sits at the back right, where the route ends. The final point of rest provides a grounding finish to your underwater journey.
